turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how are you doing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Doing well, thank you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just landed in Tokyo. It's noon here and my body thinks it's three in the morning.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Rough. Do you want to push through and stay awake till local bedtime, or grab a short nap now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, can you wait? My friend is talking to me. Keep quiet until I come back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Have you got a plaster? I cut my finger.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: In the bathroom cabinet, top shelf.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, so where were we with the shopping list?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: We still need eggs and bread.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Alex, are you sure about that move? You'll lose your whole army.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Are you trying to help me or trick me?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a bit of both.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then I'm doing it. Three dice. Come on.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ones. All three ones.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I don't want to talk about it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you want a minute?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I want a new set of dice. These ones hate me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, fighting the time difference. Which way?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Push through. I want to get it over with.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Brave. Walk around outdoors, the daylight helps reset your clock, and go to bed around ten.
